name: Tōgane (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tōgane city emblem in white: a winged ring divided by a vertical gap.
history: Municipal flag of Tōgane, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 27 September 1953.

features.role: Tōgane city emblem — a winged ring divided by a vertical gap
